correctness.rationale: The 2D assertion follows from the unit-circle characteristic function and convolution. Assuming 3D positivity, the Schoenberg radial representation and analyticity of the characteristic function force all m_k=(3/2)_k A_k/k!. Their seven-by-seven Hankel matrix has exact negative determinant -59778222499952939497463042623250744763/302231454903657293676544, and an independent integer polynomial gives a negative squared integral; both recomputed in check_certificate.py. A shorter 4D determinant -27756 corroborates the conjectural-prediction contradiction. Nonpositive determinant of a necessary moment matrix excludes all finite-dimensional R3 Gram positivity, and scaling/subspace restriction give the stated quantifiers.

value.rationale: An exact sharp dimension cutoff for the canonical three-step planar random-walk characteristic function resolves the first cubic case of an explicit conjectural power-dimension rule, revealing a qualitative failure of lifting between the well-understood Bessel square and later even powers. Its negative moment certificate is a substantive motivated theorem about an infinite family of Gram matrices, rather than arbitrary finite enumeration or a table restatement.
